reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output for a clause meeting the preferred position; nothing is proposed that could be directionally wrong.

The cited text supports compliance: § 4.1 (p0052) prices only ordered Services on a one-time, installment, recurring or usage basis with no floor, committed volume, take-or-pay or shortfall charge, matching the MINCOMMIT preferred position ('fees are for usage or ordered services only').

§ 11.5 (p0142) is correctly characterised as a Customer-side capacity-planning responsibility exercisable 'as determined by Customer' rather than a volume cap or usage restriction on Customer, so it is not a detectable commitment under the rule.
§ 3.4 (p0044–p0045) gives Customer a monthly termination-for-convenience right on one month's notice, which exceeds the fallback's 30-day reduction right and reinforces the compliant conclusion.

The early-termination-charge hook in § 3.4(b) and the non-terminated-attachment carve-out are appropriately recorded as diligence notes on out-of-scope Attachment A / Service Option Attachments rather than escalated to a deviation, consistent with the instruction not to flag minor sub-elements or unreviewed documents.
No deterministic checks failed and the rendered redline is identical to the originals, confirming a genuine no-edit compliant finding.
